style.styleTitle: London Bus First Christmas Personalised Bauble by No Ordinary Gift
style.toneOfVoice: A First Christmas bauble, featuring a red London bus made from layered wood and printed with a personalised design. The bus features a selection of four cute illustrated animals riding in the open top and waving a Union Jack flag. The side of the bus is printed with the Child’s Name and date of birth and a layer of clouds above the animals displays the text ‘First Christmas’ as standard, followed by the year. The decoration is finished with a loose dusting of artificial snow inside and measures approximately 10 x 10cm.
